# GridSolve

> Interconnection queue prediction and withdrawal-adjusted grid capacity for data center site selection.

GridSolve re-scores U.S. substations by deliverable megawatts after predicting which interconnection queue projects will withdraw. Built for data center developers, generation developers, and anyone evaluating grid interconnection headroom.

## Key pages

- Home: /
- Interconnection queue guide: /interconnection-queue
- Model methodology: /methodology

## Product

- National dataset: 4,600+ substations across 9 ISO/RTO regions and 48 states
- Cox survival model for interconnection queue withdrawal prediction
- Withdrawal-adjusted capacity (adjusted available MW) per substation
- GridSolve Site Score (0–100) for data center site selection

## Data sources

- Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory Queued Up (ISO/RTO interconnection queues)
- LBNL interconnection cost studies

## Scope

Models generation-interconnection queue projects (solar, wind, storage). Does not model large-load or data-center interconnection requests directly. Deliverable capacity is a proxy for grid headroom, not a load interconnection study.
